author: Widogeist
body: To my knowledge location is irrelevant, rewards are completely RNG. Using higher tier fishing lines will reduce the time in between catches. For example, when using the T1 fishing line it might take you 1-2 minutes (or longer) before you catch anything; using the T9 perfect fishing line will yield catches every few seconds.

author: swingincelt
body:
My opinion is that it is based on the strength of the fishing line more than location.

Also your luck stat may help and the guild gear that increases fishing luck will help.
